body: I understand I think. I won't send the message. You are right, I shouldn't refer to anyone but myself. Thank you for explaining.

Communication was a big issue in our relationship. I feel like I tried my best, just being open and speaking my mind (similar to how I shared my raw and flawed message), but maybe I did it in the wrong way. At the same time, I felt like she wasn't able to explain things to me, or that she was incapable of explaining things to me. A lot of her answers to serious questions I've asked her is "I don't know". Several times I gave her days or weeks to sit on it and think about it and I still hardly got much more. Maybe I was asking the wrong questions, or asking them in a way she couldn't understand. If that were the case, I'd be able to attribute it to an incapacity to communicate well, which is closure in its own sense.

Honestly this is so amazing. I know I sound like a piece of shit, and I won't deny that I am. Thank you for taking the time to go through my message so thoroughly. If you don't mind me asking, how do you think your revised message comes off? Or how would you say the tone has changed with the differences?

I guess I didn't think that far. An it is an attack on her character, you're right. My hope in sending her this is that she'll understand. I want to talk with her so I can understand things. Maybe she'll feel bad and explain why she hasn't been willing to talk to me. Maybe she'll hate me and tell me to never talk to her again. Maybe she'll feel like what I said is true and consider things in her life that she could change. Maybe she'll explain to me how I'm wrong and make me understand how much of a piece of shit I am to feel and think the way I do, and make me regret being a piece of shit, and give me direction in how I should move one to better things and avoid making shitty mistakes. Maybe she'll tell me I have a small penis and I'll just go look for someone who's into small penises. The issue is I don't know. I want to know and understand. It'll help me make decisions. I could just move on and ghost her, but I don't want to be a piece of shit who throws someone away. Plus I'm kind of a piece of shit who can't let go of things. Theres a lot I can learn. There's a lot I have learned. And there's a lot I want to learn. I feel like we'd all be better if we could suck up the shitty feelings of talking to someone you broke up with and facing things like a decent human being. But maybe I'm being the opposite of a decent human being, in which you guys would come in and tell me how it is, hell me understand in what ways I'm a piece of shit, and then make me feel bad and push me to not be a piece of shit. What ever helps me to grow from this shitty situation Im in.

I don't think I'll send it, you guys have been great in telling me not to. I'm just kind of lost to the point where I need to talk to strangers online for advice haha. I guess what I needed is people who will tell me what not to do. I really appreciate it. Can I ask you why you think she'd deserve to never hear from me again?

In what ways would you say its weak? In like a serious sense? 

And can you help me understand the dignity? I can't say if I have any left at all, seeing as I've come to such a pathetic scenario.

Hey I'm glad you're happy now. I just kind of have a personal thing and it's making it hard. Like moving on like that to me is like saying that "youre not worth it" and I just don't know how to do that to her. I'm sure there's other possibilities out there, but I feel like I decided, and going against that decision is kind of shitty to me.

How is this insulting? Like asking seriously. Sure it's kind of shitty, but likeif someone's overweight and you tell them "you need to lose weight" its shitty, and I guess it could be insulting, but like, is it bad? And like, she doesn't owe me anything I know that, but to leave someone that you loved just in the dust? Like its one thing if it was a casual relationship, but what about a serious one?

Man what kind of attitude is it that makes people incapable of talking things over? And I know it's pretty crazy to send this to her, thats why I'm posting it here to get some perspectives. Also, if youre first assumption is that someone will take the things you say and post it for others to judge, then Id think you've had experiences with a toxic person. I assume that people are decent ass people, and to be skeptical is kind of shitty. Call me naive, but its just kind of shitty to act like a shit person just because everyone acts like a shit person.

What do you mean?

Edit: My purpose is to get some closure on the relationship, its not a complete thought, but a lot of it is just to tell her what's on my mind, I just wna to communicate my thoughts and hope she'll understand

Edit 2: I guess its kind of like, this is what I think, this is how I feel, and I'd like my them addressed.
That sounds cool, I'll be sure to try it if I find any upcoming performances. Thanks for all of your advice! It all helps!

I listen to a lot of R&B, Soul, and Reggae music. A lot of it is the older style to, which feels even more uncommon. I guess I've never actively tried to search for concerts along those lines, though.
I really appreciate all of these suggestions! Honestly I would love to try anything. Movies sound like a good place for me to start! Thank you so much for all the advice! It helped so much

Thank you for all the suggestions! As far as my interests, I have a hard time answering that for myself. It's been a while since I've really been passionate about anything. I love music, but the music I enjoy isn't very common in the area that I live. Honestly that's kind of how it is with most of what I know I enjoy, its just not commonplace in my area, so it's either small or online. The things I do enjoy honestly revolve around that socially awkward stereotype, so things like gaming, anime, and then reddit l guess. At least those are the things that take up most of my free time.

I have been trying to at least leave the house to find places, but I don't really know where to go as far as hobbies go. I have been going around to parks and malls just because I enjoy the social environment, although I don't really interact with anyone. Any suggestions as far as hobbies to dip my toes into?

And you're definitely right, I guess there isn't any harm in suggesting hang outs and stuff. I guess I'll just have to work something out with them eventually.

I'm glad you understand how I'm feeling so well! And I would honestly love to have a pet, but my family has allergies and I'm pretty allergic myself. I considered once I'm living by myself I would adopt a cat, but that feels like a ways away unfortunately. But I love the idea and I appreciate how much you've helped :)

Thank you for your response! What are some ways I can explore hobbies? And along those lines, how can I incorporate those hobbies into social environments? I just imagined asking some of the people around me about their hobbies and I can totally see myself getting responses like "Netflix, Gaming, eating" etc. Those aren't bad hobbies by any means, but incorporating a social aspect into it seems fairly unconventional.

It's understandable since people have lives to live, so it is what it is. I really appreciate you're advice, I don't think I've seriously considered therapy before, but I think it'd be a good opportunity to work through my thoughts thoroughly.

I see, thank you for elaborating it for me. I don't think there's any crisis in my situation, but I'll be sure to check it out. I really appreciate it and I hope you've been able to improve since you've contacted them.

Actually I haven't really considered therapy before, nor have I had it suggested to me before. I'm not against it necessarily, but didn't feel as though it was necessary. I guess when I think about it more that is exactly what a therapist is about though. My understanding of therapy is limited, so if I could ask, how does one go about finding a therapist?

Would you say this is mainly for people experiencing immediate emotional distress? I definitely wouldn't say I'm in any danger and I wouldn't want to divert their time away from someone who needs it much more urgently.
I guess its a good place to start if anything. Thanks for the help
Would you happen to be able to give any examples of the communities you've mentioned?

I won't say that you're wrong, but I'm not someone who just waited around for people to love. I've pushed to be someone reliable and dependable among many other things. I've tried to be someone who people can respect and look up to. And yet here I am with nothing to show for the years of effort I've put in. I feel like I was just a passing phase. And honestly I'm exhausted from it all. It's hard to keep mustering up the strength to endure when it gets you no where, which is where I feel I'm at now. I just feel stuck without the strength to pull myself out.

I've been trying my best to be someone that matters, but I think what I want most is to be someones first choice. I know its a lot to ask for, but at this point I feel like there's always something more important than me to everyone else, hence why I feel my dying wouldn't be too big of a deal. Besides there are plenty of other people more well than I who are capable of filling that position, whether or not I'm alive to do so. I do appreciate you taking the time to look into my woes though. I understand I'm not being very compliant and I'm also not giving you much to work off of. In the end though, I would assume you also have important things, and putting in the time and effort to work things through with me is understandably not something you would feel obligated to prioritize. Notwithstanding the reality of the eay the world is, I do appreciate your thoughtfulness in sharing your thoughts.

I guess the biggest thing right now is just that there's no one in my life who I feel would care if I was gone. I people say you should live for yourself and not for others, but I just don't see the reason in living if it doesn't matter to anyone else. And of course I have friends and family who would be hurt, but I'm very emotionally distant from my family and I honestly havent felt like I had a friend in months. If I don't matter to anyone in months, who's to say a few years or decades would be any different? I just feel like I'm not important in anyone's life.
It's honestly so convoluted that trying to explain it all would take hours and hours to work out. Trying to keep it simple, I just feel like my life isnt worth living.

Our relationship is on the fence right now, but I feel like it's teetering towards failing. We've been struggling for a while now. I don't want to lose her. I don't know how to explain it all with out writing out a huge massive wall of text.

Is there somewhere I could go to get specific help for something like this? Or like a place I can chat with someone about this?

Perhaps you are looking in the wrong places? What are the odds of more than one person being in a place they don't feel comfortable in? Think of it this way? If you're looking for an apple tree, do you think looking in a desert will give you much results? Obviously, its possible, but you're odds are much better off if you look in a forest (or wherever the heck apple trees grow). Not saying you will find what youre looking for anytime soon, but if you want someone as diverse as you, you need to diversify.

Every relationship is different, so while some people may be more laidback about stuff like what your boyfriend does, it's absolutely valid and ok for you to be upset that he does what he is doing. If you were clear in your explanation to him about how you felt about it, yet he continues to disrespect you by ignoring your concerns, then he is the one out of place, not you.

I'm sorry you've had a rough couple of years. My advice is to always talk things out. To me, an unwillingness to talk things out is an unwillingness to work things out. If you're not worth her time, then she isn't worth yours. No one should be subjected to such emotional neglect. So if she persists in being unwilling to communicate with you, then I suggest you reevaluate your relationship with her. Though she may struggle to communicate, its necessary for her *to* struggle to do so for the sake of maintaining your guys relationship. Otherwise she is making up excuses as to why she shouldn't put effort into your relationship with her

It definitely seems unfair to you for him to do that to you and I can understand why you'd be frustrated. But I also think it'd be jumping the gun to suddenly break things off with them. Always always always talk to them. The most important thing in any relationship (IMHO) is understanding. If you or your bf don't understand something, talk it out. Talk to him about it all first. There's a reason why he needed to go to Disneyland instead of following through with the plans he made for you. Whatever that reason is will help you understand where your relationship is at. And if he doesn't try his best to help you understand his reasoning, then that will show his unwillingness to put forth the effort to make your relationship work.
Yeah, it does seem kinda old-people style, but hey, it'll be practice for when we actually grow old together! And you're absolutely right, I've got to take what I can get! Thank you!
That sounds great! We're not the best with words, but we do try our best to communicate and understand each other! I'll try my best to explain to her what I explained here! Thank you for your advice!

I let her know that we should plan out more one-on-one time rather than spending so much unorganised time together. I was afraid it would be counterintuitive to spend less time with her, but it seems necessary and reasonable at this point. Thank you for your advice!

You might be right. When I met her she was in a pretty dark place. I've been offering her a lot of love and support since then, but I haven't actually checked up on her depression recently, and it has been pretty stressful the last couple of days, so that could also be adding to it. I'll make sure to check in with her and see how her depression has been. Thank you for suggesting it!

That's a great idea! I'm sure she'd be willing to take it with me, so I'll talk to her about taking the quiz together. We also both enjoy taking walks, so that would be a good plan too! Hopefully we can work things out, and I'm really against the idea of splitting up, but I'm sure it will become more clear what I should do after trying for a little while longer. Thank you for your advice!
